limits: Native kernel calibration verifies the original pipeline and CPU-derived control audit, not candidate numerical equivalence.
GX substitutes CPU-known cache-position and tokenizer-length values while preserving GPU reads/writes/reductions; audit Python overhead is included.
CPU T5 construction uses strict assignment from mmap BF16 weights to avoid temporary FP32 allocations; same unmeasured setup for both variants.
Explicit low-memory text offload matches the A100 public branch; rounded GX free-memory reporting would otherwise choose a different policy.
Fixed geometry makes the declared multi-PCV fits rank-deficient. Conditional fits explain most cost, but are not general interfaces across unseen geometries.
Attention launches with key lengths 512 to 32760 alias to a single kernel signature; early samples do not cover all contexts.
cuDNN launch names/shapes differ between GX variants despite only changing metadata placement; tiny timing delta is not a clean speedup estimate.
CPU calibration is from the GX host, not the A100 CPU; 6652 of 30302 instruction samples are unresolved.
Baseline modeled idle is a prioritization signal, not a mathematical upper bound on native CPU optimization.
